name: repair-test
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /candidate-install/setup.bash; then source /candidate-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=221 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/review-evidence/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/candidate; cd /candidate; source /repair-install/setup.bash
colcon --log-base /review-evidence/repair-test-log test --base-paths /repair-source/src/mtc_moveit_planner --packages-select mtc_moveit_planner --build-base /repair-build --install-base /repair-install --executor sequential --return-code-on-test-failure
colcon test-result --test-result-base /repair-build --all
